entries.note: Specimen demonstrates rapid lifecycle progression. Estimated gestation to adult: 4-6 hours under standard conditions.
Hemolymph is molecular acid. Hull-penetrating capability confirmed in lab conditions.
Organism uses viable mammalian hosts for juvenile stage. Host does not survive emergence.
As bioweapon: uncontrolled lethality. Recommend live specimen study before any deployment consideration.
Standard containers insufficient after juvenile stage. Adult specimens can breach any known shipboard containment.
